caption: The drawing depicts a folded square piece of fabric, likely a handkerchief or napkin, centered on a plain, light-colored background. The fabric is primarily a pale shade, possibly white or light cream, and features a decorative design along two adjacent edges. The design includes large, scalloped floral motifs in shades of yellow and pale green, accented with dark red and pinkish outlines. Alongside the flowers, there are looping lines and dotted patterns in a reddish hue following the fabric's border. Scattered across the central area of the fabric are smaller yellow floral motifs with red accents. The artist's signature, "J V LUBRANO," appears in the lower left corner of the image. The overall composition suggests an object carefully arranged to highlight both the overall pattern and the border design.
title: Printed Textile
